title: Year of The Dragon, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Coin and elegant jewelry in one Highest quality silver Classic, tasteful design A gift expressing good fortune and happiness It’s a good idea to have your good luck charm always with you. That’s why this coin is not only a work of fine minting art, but also a piece of tasteful jewelry! It will bring you good luck throughout the entire Chinese Year of the Wood Dragon. Experts in the mysteries of the Chinese zodiac reveal that during this time you can expect incoming abundance and great opportunities for growth.
